nodes.name: Issuance Gate
nodes.notes: P7.2 issuance gate. Reads the decision the cycle gate made; re-proves the key format before any INSERT. Does not re-decide.

nodes.name: IF Issuance Fault
nodes.notes: Fail-closed first. A faulted issuance never reaches the preallocation branch and never reaches Save Bot Session.

nodes.name: IF Preallocation Required
nodes.notes: TRUE only for MINT. CARRY / CARRY_MALFORMED / LEGACY_NO_KEY create no receipt, so they rejoin the ordinary flow directly — there is nothing new to confirm.

nodes.name: Receipt Preallocate
nodes.notes: ISSUANCE_ORDER step 2. onError:continueRegularOutput is load-bearing — a store failure must reach the verdict node and fail closed there, not throw at a user whose message has already been delivered.

nodes.name: Receipt Readback
nodes.notes: Exact-key readback. alwaysOutputData so an ABSENT receipt still reaches the verdict instead of silently skipping the branch (P4 zero-item semantics). returnAll so a DUPLICATE is visible rather than truncated to one.

nodes.name: Issuance Verdict
nodes.notes: ISSUANCE_ORDER steps 3-5. Cardinality AND content. An insert that returned success is not confirmation, because the store cannot refuse a second row for the same key.

nodes.name: IF Authority May Advance
nodes.notes: ISSUANCE_ORDER step 6. The ONLY edge on which a minted cycle may reach Save Bot Session.

nodes.name: Build Issuance Failure Event
nodes.notes: Fail-closed terminal. The proposed session is discarded; the OLD cycle stays authoritative. The key value is never written to Bot_Events.

nodes.name: Save Bot Session
nodes.notes: PATCHED staging mode: continueOnFail=false so Bot_Sessions persistence errors are visible during runtime QA. Keep appendOrUpdate by chat_id.

nodes.name: Authority Reread
nodes.notes: Post-authority reread. Parameters are a VERBATIM copy of Read Bot Sessions — same document, same A:AV range, same credential — so the two reads cannot disagree about what the sheet looks like.

nodes.name: Authority Verdict
nodes.notes: Tells a concurrent winner apart from a lagging read by the cycle timestamp, and the same-millisecond collision apart by the key. Refuses only on a PROVABLE loss.

nodes.name: IF Authority Current
nodes.notes: The only edge on which a lead may be handed to Intake. A losing turn ends at the event row.

nodes.name: Build Stale Authority Event
nodes.notes: Lead handoff refused because this turn lost the authority row. No lead reaches Intake under a key that is no longer current.

nodes.name: HARNESS Entry
nodes.notes: Test-only entry. No public URL, no bot, no transport secret. Driven by the credential-free driver workflow, which is the thing actually tested.

nodes.name: Telegram Client Trigger
nodes.notes: HARNESS SUBSTITUTION. Keeps the production node NAME because Parse Telegram Update resolves it by name; is a Code node so it holds no credential and cannot register.

nodes.name: HARNESS Delivery Stub
nodes.notes: HARNESS SUBSTITUTION for Send Client Message + IF Message Delivered. No Telegram node executes and the live transport workflow is never called.
